about_the_game: This is a simulation game where you play as a robot to explore a planet. You are free to drive vehicles, attack with weapons, and more advanced weapons; Such as controllable missiles....... In the official version you can also fish freely build, using the backpack system. Use the workbench to synthesize items, trade with merchants, and play remotely with other players (these features will only be available in the official version and may not be available in the beta). We tried to be as detailed as possible in what we implemented. For example, the player needs to manually open the door and use the move button to enter the interior of the car and interact with the control screen before driving the vehicle. Or a hedge engine that can be turned on manually. And streetlight fences that can be easily crushed and destroyed by vehicles and then extinguished after they shatter. But individual developers have limited energy, so don't expect too much
